Company: Quantum Micro-Circuits
Position: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer Intern
Location: San Jose, CA
Duration: 6 months

About the Opportunity:
Quantum Micro-Circuits pioneers high-frequency hardware accelerators and embedded sensor interfaces for aerospace applications. We are seeking an Embedded Systems Intern with deep low-level hardware and microcontroller programming experience.

Key Responsibilities:
• Write bare-metal firmware drivers for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and RISC-V processors in C and assembly.
• Design, synthesize, and verify digital logic cores on Xilinx FPGAs using Verilog and VHDL.
• Debug low-level timing constraints using digital storage oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG hardware probes.
• Maintain real-time operating system (FreeRTOS) task schedulers and interrupt service routines.

Required Qualifications:
• Enrolled in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related degree.
• Proficient in C, C++, Verilog, RTOS, and Assembly programming.
• Experience with FPGA synthesis, timing closure, and hardware debugging.
• Understanding of serial protocols: SPI, I2C, CAN bus, UART.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Hands-on experience with Altium Designer for schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout.
• Familiarity with RF circuit testing and thermal simulation.
